name: LearnBot
description: An autoplayer that learns a route by simulation: it rewinds to a checkpoint before each death, tries earlier inputs until it survives, and saves the result. Refuses to run on medium, insane or extreme demons.

enabled.name: Enable LearnBot
enabled.description: Arm the bot. Restart the level to apply - it decides what to do when a level starts.

search-back.name: Search window (ticks)
search-back.description: How far before a death the bot may try an earlier input. Each tick is 1/240 of a second. Bigger finds more fixes but each death costs more time.

lookahead-ticks.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: How long a candidate fix must survive past the death before it is accepted.

rewind-percent.name: Rewind distance (%)
rewind-percent.description: When no single input fix works, restart this far before the death. Each further failure doubles the distance.

checkpoint-every.name: Checkpoint interval (ticks)
checkpoint-every.description: How often a rewind point is stored while playing. Lower means faster repair searches but more state to hold.

max-ticks.name: Max ticks per pass
max-ticks.description: Hard stop for one learning pass (240 ticks = one second of level).

max-rewinds.name: Max rewinds per death
max-rewinds.description: How many times the bot backs up and tries a different branch before giving up on a section.

debug-console.name: Open a debug window
debug-console.description: On Windows this opens a separate console window next to the game, written in plain English. Everywhere else the same messages go to learnbot.log in the mod's save folder.

debug-detail.name: Also show technical detail
debug-detail.description: Adds the numbers behind each message (ticks, simulated steps). Leave off for plain-English only.

effort.name: How hard it thinks
effort.description: 1 = a few seconds, 10 = about ten minutes of thinking per level. Higher finds more fixes and takes longer.

max-search-back.name: Widest search window (ticks)
max-search-back.description: How far before a crash it may look for inputs to change, in 1/240 s steps. Widening this is what lets it fix misses that happened long before the crash, like a missed orb.

max-depth.name: Inputs changed at once
max-depth.description: 1 = move a single click. 2 = two clicks together. Higher is smarter but much slower.

noclip-while-learning.name: Noclip while learning
noclip-while-learning.description: Required: the learning pass must survive a hit so it can record exactly where it would have died. With this off, LearnBot will not start a learning pass.

noclip-fallback.name: Noclip fallback while playing
noclip-fallback.description: Also skip hits during live playback, so the run always finishes. Clearly cheating; off by default.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Never save progress from a run the bot took part in.

inject-offset.name: Input offset (ticks)
inject-offset.description: Shifts every learned input this many ticks earlier (negative) or later (positive). Use this if the replay is consistently off by a tick.

jump-clearance-min.name: Jump: nearest distance
jump-clearance-min.description: Jump when a hazard is at least this far ahead (game units; one block is 30).

jump-clearance-max.name: Jump: furthest distance
jump-clearance-max.description: Jump when a hazard is at most this far ahead.

flying-lookahead.name: Flying lookahead
flying-lookahead.description: How far ahead ship and wave modes aim for the middle of the free corridor.

orb-reach.name: Orb reach
orb-reach.description: How close the bot has to be to press a ring (orb). Game units.

pad-avoid-distance.name: Pad avoidance
pad-avoid-distance.description: Jump pads fire on their own, so the bot stops pressing jump this close to one.

pit-jump-distance.name: Pit jump distance
pit-jump-distance.description: Jump when the ground ends within this distance.
